related.title: Classical Shadows：可觀測量數量與局部性
related.titleEn: Classical shadows: observable count and locality
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只報每Clifford平均值，不在缺乏分解假設下宣稱每個基底閘都同為0.5%錯誤。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report the perClifford mean, not identical0.5% errors for every basis gate without a decomposition model. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 比較目標數量的對數成本與可觀測量局部性的指數代價。
related.differenceEn: Compare logarithmic dependence on target count with exponential dependence on observable locality.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。擬合α=0.99，序列長度含1、10、20、50、100；A、B自由擬合。 EPC=(1−0.99)/2。 代入 (1-0.99)/2，得到 0.005 error/Clifford。單量子位元去極化模型下EPC=(1−α)/2，擬合P(m)=Aα^m+B；A與B吸收部分SPAM，不保證消除所有漂移。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。k=2、M=100、δ=0.05、ε=0.1，所有目標在收集資料前確定。 W=9ln(4000)/0.01。 代入 3**2*log(2*100/0.05)/0.1**2，得到 7464.64 comparative workload units。採本課工作量指標W=3^k ln(2M/δ)/ε²，借用局部Pauli估計的尺度；常數取1僅供比較，不是保證樣本數。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Fitα=0.99 using lengths1,10,20,50,100 with freeA/B. EPC=(1−0.99)/2. Substituting (1-0.99)/2 gives 0.005 error/Clifford. For a one-qubit depolarizing modelEPC=(1−α)/2 withP(m)=Aα^m+B;A/B absorb someSPAM but not all drift. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. k=2,M=100,δ=0.05,ε=0.1,with targets selected before data collection. W=9ln(4000)/0.01. Substituting 3**2*log(2*100/0.05)/0.1**2 gives 7464.64 comparative workload units. Use teaching workloadW=3^k ln(2M/δ)/ε², reflecting localPauli scaling; prefactor1 is comparative, not a certified sample guarantee. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Rigetti 超導控制：Rabi 面積與 π 脈衝
related.titleEn: Rigetti superconducting control: Rabi area and π pulses
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只報每Clifford平均值，不在缺乏分解假設下宣稱每個基底閘都同為0.5%錯誤。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report the perClifford mean, not identical0.5% errors for every basis gate without a decomposition model. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『Rigetti 超導控制：Rabi 面積與 π 脈衝』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付Rabi曲線、角度誤差與兩種原因的辨識表。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Rigetti superconducting control: Rabi area and π pulses', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a Rabi curve, angle error and a two-cause discrimination table.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。擬合α=0.99，序列長度含1、10、20、50、100；A、B自由擬合。 EPC=(1−0.99)/2。 代入 (1-0.99)/2，得到 0.005 error/Clifford。單量子位元去極化模型下EPC=(1−α)/2，擬合P(m)=Aα^m+B；A與B吸收部分SPAM，不保證消除所有漂移。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：共振兩能階模型P1=sin²(Ωt/2)；以f_R=Ω/(2π)表示時P1=sin²(π f_R t)。 使用合成f_R=10 MHz，t=50 ns；忽略失諧、洩漏及包絡整形。 以手算或試算表計算名義式sin(pi*10e6*50e-9)**2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以θ=2πf_Rt先算角度，再用(1−cosθ)/2交叉檢查；ns與MHz乘積需含10⁻³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Fitα=0.99 using lengths1,10,20,50,100 with freeA/B. EPC=(1−0.99)/2. Substituting (1-0.99)/2 gives 0.005 error/Clifford. For a one-qubit depolarizing modelEPC=(1−α)/2 withP(m)=Aα^m+B;A/B absorb someSPAM but not all drift. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a resonant two-level model P1=sin²(Ωt/2)=sin²(π f_R t), where f_R=Ω/(2π). Use Synthetic f_R=10 MHz and t=50 ns; detuning, leakage and shaping are omitted. Evaluate nominal expression sin(pi*10e6*50e-9)**2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Calculate θ=2πf_Rt, then cross-check using(1−cosθ)/2; ns times MHz includes10⁻³.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
